patterns: APPSC asks single-fact items: Article for panchayat reservation (243D), share of PRI seats for women in AP (1/2), GGGI publisher/rank in a given year, 106th Amendment assent year.
Other PSCs lean heavily on 'women firsts' (first woman Speaker, CM, Governor, President's sequence number) - simple name-recall MCQs.
Common traps: 1/3 of SC/ST seats for SC/ST women (not 1/4 or 1/2); 128th Bill = 106th Act; no quota in Rajya Sabha/Councils; Arunachal exempt from SC panchayat reservation.
App MCQs add many current-affairs items (131st Bill 2026, Bokkasam Palem, MoPR schemes) and multi-statement items that APPSC rarely uses for this topic.
